response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_average FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), above_overall AS (SELECT ta.avg_pulse FROM telescope_averages ta WHERE ta.avg_pulse > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg)), second_threshold AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_average FROM above_overall), final_set AS (SELECT ao.avg_pulse FROM above_overall ao WHERE ao.avg_pulse > (SELECT second_average FROM second_threshold)) SELECT AVG(fs.avg_pulse) as mean_average_pulse_rate, AVG(fs.avg_pulse) - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as avg_above_overall_average, AVG(fs.avg_pulse) - (SELECT second_average FROM second_threshold) as avg_above_second_average FROM final_set fs
